summary: The customer called because she received an email stating her order was cancelled and wanted to know about her refund status. The agent located the order, explained that the item was out of stock which caused an automatic cancellation, and confirmed a full refund would take 3 to 5 business days to appear on her credit card. The customer expressed satisfaction and ended the call.

evidence.text: بس رح ياخذ 3 لـ 5 أيام عمل لحتى يظهر بالحساب.
evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Refund will appear in the account within 3 to 5 business days.

evidence.text: أهلاً معك رامي، كيف بقدر أساعدك اليوم؟
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent was polite, welcoming, and maintained a helpful and courteous tone throughout the entire call.

evidence.text: ولا يهمك سيدي، خليني أشيك لك على السيستم.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent reassured the customer right away ('ولا يهمك') and apologized for the inconvenience when explaining the automatic cancellation.

evidence.text: أكيد، full refund راح يرجع لك كامل المبلغ بدون أي خصومات نهائياً.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent successfully answered all the customer's questions regarding the refund timeframe, the reason for cancellation, and whether any deductions would apply.

evidence.text: بياخد من ثلاثة لخمسة business days، يعني خلال هالأسفل بيكون نازل عندك بالـ account.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent communicated clearly, repeating and clarifying the refund timeline when asked by the customer, although slightly mixing Arabic and English slang terms.

evidence.text: في شي تاني بقدر أساعدك فيه؟
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent checked if there was anything else needed, waited for the customer's closure, and closed with appropriate pleasantries.

evidence.text: بالنسبة للفلوس، it was processed for a full refund اليوم، بس رح ياخذ 3 لـ 5 أيام عمل لحتى يظهر بالحساب.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent provided accurate information about the refund being processed today and the exact standard timeline of 3 to 5 business days.
The agent followed proper procedure by asking for and verifying the order number before looking up account details in the system.

quote.text: أنا شوي مخربطة باللي صار، I got an email إنو my order cancelled، بس بدي أعرف شو صار بالفلوس تبعتي؟
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: عذراً، ما فهمت منيح، قديش بدو وقت لحتى ينزل بالحساب؟
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: آه، okay فهمت. طيب ليش الـ order صار إلـه cancellation من أساسه؟ I didn't cancel it!
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: طيب يعني أنا ما عملت شي غلط؟ And I will get all my money back بدون أي deductions؟
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: ممتاز، شكراً كثير إلك، تعبتك معي لأني شوي ضايعة اليوم.
quote.speaker: Customer
